name: 44054 · Sheffield Vlg, OH
findings: ZIP 44054 (Sheffield Vlg) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44054 (Sheffield Vlg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
